question: The Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army) was reorganised by Subhas Chandra Bose in which country?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Singapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Azad Hind Fauj (Indian National Army)** was reorganised by **Subhas Chandra Bose** in **Singapore** in 1943.
 
• Singapore played a key role as it was under the control of the **Imperial Japanese Army** during World War II, which supported Bose's efforts.
 
• The formation of the INA was aimed at liberating India from Britis
